Find a workbook's sheet for one step

Source: R/fiss_parse.R
knw_fiss_match_sheet.Rd

Sheet names drift across the template's editions ("Step 4 (Stream Site Data)", "Step 4 (Site Card Data)", "Fish collection"), so each step is found by a pattern on the lower-cased name (see knw_fiss_columns()).

Usage

knw_fiss_match_sheet(sheets, step)

Arguments

sheets

character, the workbook's sheet names (readxl::excel_sheets()).

step

string, one of "step1_ref_loc", "step2_fish_coll", "step3_indiv_fish", "step4_site_data".

Value

string, the first sheet that matches, or NA when none does (a tissue-data workbook or a reach summary).

Examples

sheets <- c("INSTRUCTIONS", "Step 1 (Ref. and Loc. Info)", "Step 2 (Fish Coll. Data)",
            "Step 3 (Individual Fish Data)", "Step 4 (Site Card Data)")
knw_fiss_match_sheet(sheets, "step4_site_data")
#> [1] "Step 4 (Site Card Data)"
knw_fiss_match_sheet("Tissue", "step2_fish_coll")
#> [1] NA
